description: Scrape hyperlocal US news, events and classifieds from Patch.com by keyword, town, category, author, tag or URL, with optional full body text, detail-page enrichment and new-record monitoring.

authorName.description: Exact byline/reporter/poster name (required for mode=byAuthor; on any other mode it is an extra server-side filter). Copy it from this actor's `author` output field, e.g. "Eric Heyl".
authorName.title: Author name

category.description: News category/topic to filter by (required for mode=byCategory; optional filter on mode=search/byTown/byAuthor/byTag). Not applicable to mode=events/classifieds -- use `classifiedCategory` for mode=classifieds instead.
category.title: Category

classifiedCategory.description: Classifieds category to filter by (mode=classifieds only; a completely separate value set from `category`, which is news-only). Leave as "(any category)" to browse every classified category.
classifiedCategory.title: Classified category

eventDateAfter.description: mode=events only. Only include events occurring on or after this date (the event's own date, not when it was posted to Patch -- see `publishedAfter` for that). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Combine with `eventDateBefore` for a date range, e.g. "what's happening this weekend".
eventDateAfter.title: Event date after (YYYY-MM-DD)

eventDateBefore.description: mode=events only. Only include events occurring on or before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Combine with `eventDateAfter` for a date range.
eventDateBefore.title: Event date before (YYYY-MM-DD)

includeBodyText.description: Add bodyHtml (the original HTML), bodyText (readable plain text) and bodyLength to each record. Article/event/classified bodies come from Patch's own search payload, so this costs no extra request.
includeBodyText.title: Include full body text

includeDetails.description: Fetch each record's Patch page and add gallery images/captions/credits, author avatar and points, comment/reply counts, breaking/sponsored flags, town grade/weekly views/ZIPs/timezone/county/metro, event venue/type/website, and classified contact state. One extra request per record; failed pages never discard the base record.
includeDetails.title: Enrich from detail pages

maxDetails.description: How many records to enrich when `includeDetails` is on. 0 means every emitted record (up to `maxItems`). Ignored when detail enrichment is off.
maxDetails.title: Max detail pages

maxItems.description: Maximum number of articles, events or classifieds to return (1-1000). Requests above 250 are automatically split into date partitions to bypass Patch's 250-hit search-key window.
maxItems.title: Max results

enumTitles: Browse latest news for a town/city
Scrape Patch URLs (article, event, classified, town, topic, state or search)
mode.title: Mode

monitorKey.description: Optional namespace for monitor state. Give different saved tasks different keys to keep their seen-ID lists separate. Derived automatically from the mode and filters when empty.
monitorKey.title: Monitor key

monitorMode.description: Emit only records whose Patch ID has not been seen by an earlier run with the same monitor key. State is stored in the actor's key-value store.
monitorMode.title: Monitor: only new records

nearLat.description: Latitude of a point to search near (combine with `nearLng` and `radiusMiles`). News modes only (search/byTown/byCategory/byAuthor/byTag) -- not available for mode=events/classifieds, whose Patch indexes don't expose a filterable location field. Both `nearLat` and `nearLng` must be set together; otherwise this filter is ignored.
nearLat.title: Near latitude

nearLng.description: Longitude of a point to search near (combine with `nearLat` and `radiusMiles`). News modes only -- see `nearLat` description. Both `nearLat` and `nearLng` must be set together; otherwise this filter is ignored.
nearLng.title: Near longitude

publishedAfter.description: Only include articles/events/classifieds posted to Patch on or after this date (i.e. listing date, not an event's own occurrence date -- see `eventDateAfter` for that). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Combine with `publishedBefore` for a date range.
publishedAfter.title: Published after (YYYY-MM-DD)

publishedBefore.description: Only include articles/events/classifieds posted to Patch on or before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Combine with `publishedAfter` for a date range.
publishedBefore.title: Published before (YYYY-MM-DD)

radiusMiles.description: Search radius around `nearLat`/`nearLng`, in miles. News modes only -- see `nearLat` description. Ignored unless both `nearLat` and `nearLng` are set.
radiusMiles.title: Radius (miles)

regionSlug.description: US state/edition to scope results to (required for mode=byTown; optional filter on every other mode). "Across America" is Patch's national edition (code US); "US Territories" is a valid Patch region with no current articles.
regionSlug.title: State

searchMatch.description: How multi-word searches match. "All words" requires every word anywhere in the headline/summary/topic (more results). "Exact phrase" requires the words to appear together (the old behavior).
searchMatch.title: Search match

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword to search for (mode=search; also applies to mode=events/classifieds and to scope URLs). Leave empty to browse the newest articles matching the other filters.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Order of results. "Nearest first" requires both `nearLat`/`nearLng` AND mode=search/byTown/byCategory/byAuthor/byTag (news); otherwise it falls back to Relevance. "Soonest event first" requires mode=events; on any other mode it also falls back to Relevance.
enumTitles: Nearest first (requires nearLat/nearLng, news modes only)
sortBy.title: Sort by

startUrls.description: mode=byUrl only. Paste Patch article, event, classified, town, category/topic, state or search URLs. Article/event/classified URLs are scraped directly; town/topic/state/search URLs are converted into the equivalent scoped query.

url.description: A full Patch.com URL (or patch.com/... path).
url.title: URL

startUrls.title: Patch URLs

tagName.description: Exact editorial tag (required for mode=byTag; on article modes it is an extra filter). Copy it from this actor's `tags` field, e.g. "Back To School". Only a minority of articles carry tags.
tagName.title: Tag name

townSlug.description: Patch town/city URL slug (required for mode=byTown; requires regionSlug too). Find it in a Patch URL, e.g. patch.com/california/santamonica -> "santamonica". Example: "santamonica" (with regionSlug=california).
townSlug.title: Town/city slug

title: Patch Scraper Input
